Skilled in data modeling, Excel, SQL, Power BI, and related analytical tools.","lines":[{"i":0,"text":"Developed a full-stack corporate website with React and Flask, organizing product data to improve navigation and automate customer inquiries via an AI chatbot."},{"i":2,"text":"Implemented a three-factor authentication system using face, voice, and gesture recognition, applying deep learning models to improve verification accuracy and reliability."},{"i":3,"text":"Reduced unauthorized access attempts by approximately 60% using a three-layer biometric validation pipeline."},{"i":5,"text":"Analyzed RBI UPI transaction datasets with SQL and DAX to evaluate payment trends and state-wise growth, delivering KPI-driven insights into transaction velocity and market expansion."},{"i":6,"text":"Built a five-page interactive Power BI dashboard integrating transaction, channel, and customer data to reveal behavioral patterns and performance metrics."},{"i":8,"text":"Engineered a fraud detection system analyzing over 500,000 GST transaction records to identify shell entities and circular trading patterns, structuring relational datasets and automating graph construction for scalable risk analysis."},{"i":9,"text":"Built a fraud risk scoring model achieving 87% accuracy with less than 5% false positives."},{"i":10,"text":"Delivered four interactive dashboards for fraud network visualization and risk-based case prioritization."}]}
